summary: Shelf Tracker: A personal home-library tracker that records books, their authors and categories, and who has borrowed them—so you always know what is on your shelf and what is out on loan.
implemented_features: Add a book to the collection
Edit or remove a book entered by mistake
Lend a book out and mark it returned
Filter the list to on-shelf or lent-out
See how many books are lent out right now
assumptions: Built for A single individual managing their personal book collection on their own computer..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage under a single key; books array is serialized on every mutation and rehydrated on startup.
